node.title: Re: deconstructing tinydns(djbdns) SRV records (updated)
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
[Corion] [id://1198005|is right] that if there is an appropriate module to do this for you, you should use that.  For example as [VinsWorldcom] demonstrated [id://1198010|here]. 

If it turns out you do need to do this yourself, here are two ideas based on [doc://unpack] (templates explained in [doc://perlpacktut] and [doc://pack]) and [doc://perlre|regexes]. The first is a little more robust in its parsing, the second a little shorter and simpler.

my $data = "\000\012\000\144\023\304\003pbx\007example\003com\000:3600"; my ($pri,$weight,$port,$rest) = unpack "S>3A*", $data; my $target=''; $target .= (length($target)?'.':'').$2 while $rest=~/\G([\x01-\xFF])((??{".{".ord($1)."}"}))/saagc; my ($ttl) = $rest=~/\G\x00:(.+)\z/saagc or die "failed to parse"; # - OR - my ($pri,$weight,$port,$target,$ttl) = unpack "S>3Z*A*", $data; $target = join '.', unpack "(C/A)*", $target; $ttl=~s/\A://;
